title: Israel kills Iranian nuclear scientists first

tellings.quote: Who were the first people the Israelis killed in Iran when they went in?

plain: When Israel went into Iran, the first people it killed were said to be Iranian scientists. The researcher Eric Weinstein makes the point to Michels as a question, "Who were the first people the Israelis killed in Iran when they went in?", and names no source. He uses it to argue that scientists who hold key knowledge are treated as strategic targets, which bears on how secret science is guarded.
